items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We were talking about Benny Goodman earlier.

ctx.x: I agree with you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

And then the whole big band era. See people don’t, they don’t give Louis credit. He kind of founded the Swing Era. Because Fletcher started writing those arrangements. We were talking about Benny Goodman earlier. And Fletcher Henderson started writing arrangements and really all he was doing, not to diminish what he was doing, but what Fletcher would do that made those arrangements so great, is he was writing, phrasing, like Louis would play. They were pop tunes from the day, but Fletcher Henderson would sit…
That’s a strong impact on everything.
